BackstoryDef.title: shrine officiant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] conducted ceremonies and organized offerings at a local shrine, listened to the requests of villagers and learned the customs and history of the shrine. When festivals approached, [PAWN_pronoun] helped organize the people preparing them.

BackstoryDef.title: shrine ritual attendant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served at a shrine, dancing kagura during festivals, preparing offerings and helping visitors. Repeated performance honed [PAWN_possessive] agility, while welcoming worshippers taught [PAWN_objective] to deal with unfamiliar people.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant ritualist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled between villages and markets, performing rites and purification ceremonies at the request of local people. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to speak with strangers and adapt to the customs of each community.

BackstoryDef.title: itinerant woodturner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled through the mountains in search of suitable timber, making wooden bowls, ladles and other utensils. [PAWN_pronoun] knew how to judge a tree and kept making tools while moving from place to place.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a family that lived by hunting, learning to recognize animal tracks and paths through the woods. [PAWN_pronoun] helped repair traps and carry game, and gradually learned to use a bow.
